title: Talking to Yourself
style: rebellious rap-rock, driving beats, electric guitars, powerful male vocals with attitude, confident and defiant energy, catchy anthemic chorus
lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey man…
You’re talking to yourself
[Chorus]
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
You talking to yourself and I wonder why
You talking to yourself and I know why
[Verse 1]
Look at yourself in the mirror, fire in your eyes
Questioning every move under these skies
I’m the bad guy with no authority
Pick the right time, teach ‘em reality
Don’t let nobody push me around
Maybe then they’ll hear the sound
They don’t understand this war in me
But I keep fighting, that’s my destiny
[Verse 2]
Just do it, this is my psychology
No sympathy for society
Don’t mess with me, you won’t get far
Change the plan, raise the bar
Attention on me, better hope you see
I know how to stand, I know how to be free
Only way I know, this is my path
Talking to yourself, doing the math
[Bridge]
No lies you think of me, forget it, let me burn
Attention to myself, better hope you learn
I know how to kick your ass with truth so raw
This fire inside, breaking every law
[Chorus]
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
Hey man, you’re talking to yourself
You’re talking to yourself and I know why
You’re talking to yourself, yeah I know why
[Verse 3]
Staring at the reflection, asking why you fight
Every thought a weapon shining in the night
No authority needed, power’s in my hands
Pick the moment, strike hard across the lands
Society’s rules are just chains to break
No sympathy for the fakes, I’m wide awake
Don’t let nobody push, I’m the storm unleashed
Talking to yourself till the doubt is released
[Outro]
Talking to yourself…
I know why…
Hey man…
You’re talking to yourself…
